dialog.english: ��������The fake sign's ready! Heeheehee!

Soon the Chosen Child will appear,
see the sign, and fall right into
my trap!
dialog.translation:
Pronto el Niño Elegido aparecerá,
verá el cartel y caerá en
mi trampa!

dialog.english:
I have to do something, or else
Lord Vamdemon will...
dialog.translation:
Debo hacer algo, o el Señor
Vamdemon...

dialog.english:
Izzy, can we rest for a bit?
I'm dead tired.
dialog.translation:
Izzy, paramos un rato?
Estoy muerto de cansancio.

dialog.english:
We have to find Gennai as soon as
possible!
dialog.translation:
Debemos encontrar a Gennai
cuanto antes!

dialog.english: But it's already been two months.
dialog.translation: Pero ya han pasado dos meses.

dialog.english:
I'll keep going, no matter how
many months it takes.
dialog.translation:
Seguiré adelante, sin importar
cuántos meses tarde.

dialog.english: Izzy! Wait for meeeeeee!

If we meet Gennai, we can learn
the secret behind the Emblemas!
dialog.translation:
Si vemos a Gennai, sabremos
el secreto de los Emblemas!

dialog.english:
You know, Izzy, the fact that
you're always curious is what I 
like about you.
dialog.translation:
Sabes, Izzy, lo que me gusta
de ti es que siempre eres
tan curioso.

dialog.english:
Stop, I'm getting embarrassed.
Anyway, where's Gennai?
dialog.translation:
Para, que me da vergüenza.
Bueno, dónde está Gennai?

dialog.english:
But we didn't even take a break!
Izzy!
dialog.translation:
Pero si no hemos descansado
nada! Izzy!

dialog.english: Ah! It's a sign.
"Beware of Falling Poop Ahead"...
What's this?

Huh? If it says that, then we
should take a detour.
dialog.translation:
Eh? Si dice eso, mejor
damos un rodeo.

dialog.english: Heeheeheehee!
This area really is full of poop.
dialog.translation: Esta zona está llena de caca.

dialog.english:
I wanna get through this mountain
as quickly as we can!
dialog.translation:
Quiero cruzar esta montaña
lo antes posible!

dialog.english: But these signs are a huge help.
Ah! Another sign!

Seems like this time we should go
this way instead.
dialog.translation:
Parece que esta vez hay que
ir por aquí.

dialog.english: Ah! Uwaaaaaaaah!
W-Waaaaaaaaaah!

I did it, I did it! A great
success!!
dialog.translation:
Lo logré, lo logré! Todo
un éxito!!

dialog.english: Aaaaaaaaaah!
Aaaaaaaaaah!
Can't you fly, Tentomon?

I can't fly! Tryin' to fly just
makes me fall right back down!
dialog.translation:
No puedo volar! Si lo intento,
solo consigo caer de nuevo!

dialog.english:
How far are we going to keep
falling?
dialog.translation:
Hasta cuándo vamos a seguir
cayendo?

dialog.english: To Hell.
Hell? Don't mess with us!
No! I don't wanna go to Hell!
dialog.translation: No! No quiero ir al Infierno!

dialog.english:
Those who are possessed by greed
will fall into Hell.
dialog.translation:
Los poseídos por la codicia
caerán al Infierno.

dialog.english:
I don't believe we're possessed by
any type of greed, but...
dialog.translation:
No creo que tengamos codicia
de ningún tipo, pero...

dialog.english:
No, you are possessed, by the
greed of wanting to know
everything.
dialog.translation:
No, estás poseído por la
codicia de querer saberlo
todo.

dialog.english: No way!
Do you want to fall into Hell?!
I don't want to faaaaaaaaaaall!
I don't, either!

Then throw away your inquisitive
heart!

But Izzy, that's what I like
about you...
dialog.translation:
Pero Izzy, eso es lo que me
gusta de ti...

dialog.english:
But at this rate we're both going
to fall into Hell!
dialog.translation:
Pero a este paso los dos
caeremos al Infierno!

dialog.english: Aaaaaaaaaah!
How do I throw it away?
Pray for it!

I don't want to know! I don't want
to know!
dialog.translation:
No quiero saber! No quiero
saber!

dialog.english: Where in tarnation are we?!
The Sacred Mysterious Universe.
A-aaaaaaaaah.
Who are you?

I am Vadermon, the ruler of the
Sacred Mysterious Universe.
dialog.translation:
Soy Vadermon, gobernante del
Sagrado Universo Misterioso.

dialog.english: Vadermon...

I will dispose of the inquisitive
heart that you've discarded.
dialog.translation:
Me desharé del corazón curioso
que has descartado.

dialog.english: Izzy...

It is much more important to
acquire Cosmic Power.
dialog.translation:
Es mucho más importante
obtener el Poder Cósmico.

dialog.english:
...much more important to acquire
Cosmic Power...
dialog.translation:
...mucho más importante tener
el Poder Cósmico...

dialog.english: Just like that. Heeheehee...

The fundamentals of Cosmic Power
lie in your breathing.
dialog.translation:
La base del Poder Cósmico está
en tu respiración.

dialog.english:
Izzy, don't get sucked into
that hogwash!
dialog.translation:
Izzy, no te tragues esas
tonterías!

dialog.english:
The correct way to breathe is to
generate alpha rays from your
right chest...
dialog.translation:
La forma correcta de respirar es
generar rayos alfa desde tu
pecho derecho...

dialog.english: Stop it!
Continue your training!
Huh? Did I dig the pit that deep?
dialog.translation: Eh? Cavé el hoyo tan hondo?

dialog.english:
I still haven't gotten the Crest.
What do I do...?
dialog.translation:
Aún no tengo el Emblema.
Qué hago...?

dialog.english:
Hm, hmmmmm! I've obtained a good
heart today.
dialog.translation:
Hmm, hmmmmm! Hoy conseguí un
buen corazón.

dialog.english:
Excuse me, have you seen a human
and a Digimon fall into this hole
anytime recently?
dialog.translation:
Disculpe, ha visto caer por aquí
a un humano y un Digimon
hace poco?

dialog.english:
I saw them, I saw them! Please
wait a moment!
dialog.translation:
Los vi, los vi! Espere un
momento, por favor!

dialog.english:
Sorry to keep you waiting! Here's
that kid's inquisitive heart!
dialog.translation:
Perdón por la espera! Aquí tiene
el corazón curioso del chaval!

dialog.english: ...his heart?

I'm the Merchant of the Heart
Universe. Haven't you come to buy
a heart?
dialog.translation:
Soy el Mercader del Universo
de los Corazones. No viene
a comprar uno?

dialog.english:
No, I want the Tag and Crest that
kid was holding!
dialog.translation:
No, quiero el Circuito y Emblema
de ese chaval!

dialog.english:
Good sir, this is a heart shop! I
don't sell that kind of thing!
dialog.translation:
Buen hombre, esto es una tienda
de corazones! No vendo eso!

dialog.english: But I've got a fine poop for you.
dialog.translation: Pero le traigo una buena caca.

dialog.english: A poop?! That's respectable!

I'd like to trade with you, you
know!
I'll do it! I'll do it!!
Izzy...

There's something I'd like to tell
you.
What's it *this* time?!

To use Cosmic Power, you must
throw everything away.
dialog.translation:
Para usar el Poder Cósmico,
debes tirarlo todo.

dialog.english: Everything?

Hand over all of your personal
belongings.
Yes. I don't need this.
Aaaaah! You can't do that!
Stay quiet!
Aaaaaaah!
Heeheehee! Now, the Crest!
Izzy! Get yourself together!
Tento...mon...
Izzy!
Tentomon...what was I...
Tch! You're back to normal!

Izzy, you're right back to
normal! Huh? Power's flowin'
through me!
dialog.translation:
Izzy, ya vuelves a ser tú!
Eh? Siento un montón de
poder recorriéndome!

dialog.english: You think you can defeat me?
Gaaaaaah!
Kabuterimon!

This is bad! I ain't got enough
power yet!
dialog.translation:
Mal asunto! Aún no tengo
poder suficiente!

dialog.english:
If I could get back my inquisitive
heart...
dialog.translation:
Si pudiera recuperar mi
corazón curioso...

dialog.english: The inquisitive heart is mine!

My curiosity is an important part
of me. I want to know. I want to
know!
dialog.translation:
Mi curiosidad es parte
importante de mí. Quiero saber.
Quiero saber!

dialog.english:
Aaaaaaah! You stole the
inquisitive heart!

Kabuterimon, get up! We'll
continue our adventure together!
dialog.translation:
Kabuterimon, levántate!
Seguiremos la aventura juntos!

dialog.english:
Izzy! What's going on? I'm
gettin' a ton of energy!
dialog.translation:
Izzy! Qué pasa? Estoy
sintiendo un montón de energía!

dialog.english:
You evolved with the power of the
Crest, AtlurKabuterimon!
dialog.translation:
Evolucionaste con el poder del
Emblema, MegaKabuterimon!

dialog.english:
What is this? But just bluffing
your way through won't defeat me!
dialog.translation:
Qué es esto? Pero un farol no
bastará para vencerme!

dialog.english: We did it, Izzy!
AtlurKabuterimon!
Is that the exit?
Let's get outta here!
Yeah!

He's taking so long. What's that
Vadermon guy doing?
dialog.translation:
Tarda mucho. Qué hace ese
tal Vadermon?

dialog.english: What?!
We're out, Izzy!
Eeeeeeeeek!
He left. Who was that Digimon?
dialog.translation: Se fue. Quién era ese Digimon?

dialog.english: I used up way too much energy.
Thank you so much, Mochimon!
Izzy...
Izzy!
Matt! T.K!
Tsunomon and Patamon!
Are you doing okay?
Yes!
Chosen Children...
Gennai!

The distortions in this world have
not been corrected yet.
dialog.translation:
Las distorsiones de este mundo
aún no se han corregido.

dialog.english: No way.

I'm counting on you, Chosen
Children...

Not again. He only says what's
convenient...
dialog.translation:
Otra vez no. Solo dice lo que
le conviene...

dialog.english:
Let's meet up with everyone again.
We'll find a way if we work
together!
dialog.translation:
Reunámonos con todos.
Encontraremos la forma si
trabajamos juntos!

dialog.english: Yeah, you're right!

"Beware of extreme poop ahead!"
What's extreme poop?
dialog.translation:
"Cuidado, caca extrema
delante" Qué es caca extrema?

dialog.english:
I don't really know, but I don't
wanna get attacked by some poop.
dialog.translation:
Ni idea, pero no quiero que
me ataque ninguna caca.

dialog.english: Let's not go in that direction.
"Beware of giant poop ahead".
You worried about giant poop?

Not "worried" per se, but let's
keep going.
dialog.translation:
No es que me "preocupe", pero
sigamos.

dialog.english:
"Beware of a bottomless pit of
poop ahead".
dialog.translation:
"Cuidado, foso sin fondo
de caca delante".

dialog.english: Don't like the sound of that one.
We should take a detour.

Izzy, I'm sick of all this
poop.
dialog.translation:
Izzy, estoy harto de tanta
caca.

dialog.english: Indeed. Let's keep going.

Izzy, you ain't interested in
poop, are you?
dialog.translation:
Izzy, a ti no te interesa la
caca, verdad?

dialog.english:
I'm not interested in poop, but
when a sign tells us not to go,
it concerns me.
dialog.translation:
No me interesa la caca, pero
si un cartel dice que no vayamos,
me preocupa.

dialog.english: Is this your inquisitive heart?
